title: Hinomori Shiho — Head-On Rematch〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna go work on my song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'll be going as well.
See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you have any plans after this, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm probably just gonna practice some stuff on my own since I don't have work today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
Mind if we walk back together for part of the way?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What kind of song do you think Saki's going to write?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
About that...
She's probably gonna try to write something about “understanding loneliness”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I also thought a lot about how or why we were able to write that song for Hanano and her brother.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is just my hunch...
But I think it's because their situation reminded me of what I went through way back when and wanted to show them my support somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What you went through way back when?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
When I couldn't see any of you and felt really lonely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to cheer past me up by saying, “It's gonna be okay!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Cheer her past self up by telling her things are gonna be okay, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki told us that there's nothing for us to worry about, but it must've been so hard for her when she was in the hospital...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And her trying to analyze what she felt back then means...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's making a sincere effort to “face the music” so to speak...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be honest, I don't really want her to reopen any old wounds...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's taking what we do as a band seriously, which makes me kinda happy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since Saki's working so hard for us, I should make an effort to learn a little more about writing music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm...? What's wrong, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I was just wondering if there was any way that I could help out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're coming up with a schedule for us, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I will...
But I was hoping that I could share the load with Saki and Ichika somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want you to keep suffering like this on your own...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. What you're doing is probably what's best for our band right now...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I absolutely don't want you to carry this weight by yourself! It doesn't seem right at all!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honami never changes. She's always looking for ways to help others out...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, I might ask you to lend a hand once Saki's finished writing her rough draft.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially when we come up with the music for each instrument. We should be able to turn it into a really good song by discussing it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
Since Saki's working so hard, I want to do as much as I possibly can for her and all of us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good. However, Saki has a habit of going a bit overboard, so promise not to push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I promise.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'm this way.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should start thinking more about our next show while Saki writes her song.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But that Saku person might be right. We may want to play at a live house where we feel more at home...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get what you're trying to say, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we do what you say and ignore what Saku said, I feel like we'd also be writing off how everyone else in the crowd felt.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki's right. If we're serious about going pro, we have to find ways to make it so our music reaches as many people as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I'm sure she'll write something good for us...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'll schedule us to play there again as a sort of rematch. We can't back down from a challenge.)
